hero.title: Give a home to those who need it most
hero.subtitle: Connecting rescued pets with loving families. 100% free adoption.

problem.title: A crisis that needs a solution
problem.subtitle: Dominican Republic faces a stray animal overpopulation
problem.stat_1: Over 2 million estimated stray animals in the country
problem.stat_2: Rescue centers operate without state support
problem.description: Animal shelters struggle with limited resources, complex bureaucratic processes, and veterinary costs that prevent adoptions. Thousands of pets wait for a home while families face barriers to adopt.

solution.title: Pelú simplifies adoption
solution.subtitle: A platform designed to connect, facilitate, and bring transparency

feature_1.title: Discover your companion
feature_1.description: Tinder-style interface to explore pet profiles. Swipe, connect, and meet your future friend.

feature_2.title: Simplified process
feature_2.description: Chat directly with rescue centers. No complicated paperwork, no unnecessary middlemen.

feature_3.title: Coordinated transport
feature_3.description: Real-time tracking of your pet. We know where they are at every moment until they arrive at your home.

feature_4.title: Ongoing support
feature_4.description: Post-adoption follow-up and access to discounted veterinary services to ensure well-being.

value_adopters.title: For adopters
value_adopters.subtitle: Everything you need to adopt responsibly
value_adopters.benefit_2: Transport with transparent pricing (pay only for logistics)
value_adopters.benefit_3: Premium option with veterinary care included
value_adopters.benefit_4: Access to all pets from rescue centers in one place
value_adopters.benefit_5: Support for adopting special needs pets

value_rescues.title: For rescue centers
value_rescues.subtitle: More adoptions, less administrative burden
value_rescues.benefit_5: Optional premium service for complete management

transparency.title: Total transparency
transparency.subtitle: We know that trust is built with clarity
transparency.pricing_description: Adoption is always free. You only pay for transport if you choose to use it, calculated based on distance (9.66 RD$ per kilometer). No hidden fees.
transparency.data_description: Your data is used solely to facilitate adoptions. We don't share information with third parties. You can delete your account at any time.
transparency.mission_description: Reduce the homeless animal population by connecting rescuers with adopters in a simple, transparent, and humane way.

cta.title: Ready to take the next step?
cta.subtitle: Thousands of pets are waiting for a home. Start today.
